name: An Old WebView Is Told To Update
note: D38 (2026-11-06): a classic inline script in index.html (scripts/build/webviewNotice.js) tells a WebView older than the build target what to do. Gate 3-24 runs the built page.

mutations.name: the notice line drifts from the build target
mutations.why: Chrome 105–110 would get the app with no word, though the bundle is built for 111 and was never seen there.
mutations.expectFailure: but the bundle is built for Chrome 111

mutations.name: Chrome 69 is offered "continue anyway"
mutations.why: Below 105 the app cannot run (Chrome 69 stops at its first line) — continuing leads to the dark screen the notice exists to explain.
mutations.expectFailure: no "continue anyway" into a dark screen

mutations.name: "continue anyway" is not remembered
mutations.why: A player on WebView 108 who chose to go on is stopped by the same notice at every start.
mutations.expectFailure: so the next start does not ask again

mutations.name: the saved language is ignored
mutations.why: A player who chose Japanese in the app, on an English phone, is told in English.

mutations.name: Arabic is laid out left to right
mutations.why: The Arabic notice reads in the wrong direction.

mutations.name: the notice script uses syntax an old WebView cannot read
mutations.why: On Chrome 69 the notice itself would stop at the same `?.` that stops the app — the dark screen again.

mutations.name: the script goes into <head>
mutations.why: It would run before <body> exists and stop at document.body.appendChild — no notice.
mutations.expectFailure: a classic <script> at the end of <body>

mutations.name: a string's < goes into the page raw
mutations.why: A translation holding </script> would end the notice script in the HTML parser; the rest of it would show as text on the page (review 2026-11-20).
mutations.expectFailure: the HTML parser would end the notice script there

mutations.name: U+2028 goes into the page raw
mutations.why: Before ES2019 (Chrome below 66, the WebViews this notice is for) it is a line break inside a string: the notice dies of a syntax error (review 2026-11-20).
